# Setup and file paths

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(readxl)
library(knitr)
```

```{r import-data}
# ============================================================
# FILE PATHS — UPDATE THESE BEFORE RUNNING ON THE REAL DATA
# ============================================================

# ---- UPDATE PATH 1: DATASET ----
data_file <- "data/raw/synthetic_data.csv"

# ---- UPDATE PATH 2: MASTER CODEBOOK ----
codebook_file <- "Dissertation_Aim1_Master_Codebook.xlsx"

# ============================================================
# IMPORT DATA AND CODEBOOK — NO PATH CHANGES NEEDED BELOW HERE
# ============================================================

dat <- read_csv(data_file)
region_codes  <- read_excel(codebook_file, sheet = "Region Codes")
comuna_codes  <- read_excel(codebook_file, sheet = "Comuna Codes")
closure_codes <- read_excel(codebook_file, sheet = "Closure Codes")
country_codes <- read_excel(codebook_file, sheet = "Country Codes")
```

# Analysis population and definitions

Include all individuals in the registry, without age or year restrictions.

For each individual (`id_persona`):

1. Select the earliest dated registry record to define age, year, sex, region, FONASA category, and establishment level. If no dated record exists, retain the individual with unknown first-registration year.
2. Determine whether any available record is confirmed and non-discarded (`ipd_cofirmado == "SI"` and `ipd_descartado == "NO"`).

Report the proportion with observed confirmation overall and by first-registration year, age, sex, region, FONASA category, and establishment level.

# Analysis

## Prepare registry variables

```{r prepare-data}
required <- c(
  "id_persona", "fecha_creacion_caso", "edad_ano_creacion_caso",
  "ipd_cofirmado", "ipd_descartado", "cmd_sexo_benef",
  "cmd_cod_deis_regi_benef", "cmd_carga_tramo_benef",
  "desc_nivel_estab_crea_caso"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(required, names(dat))

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Required variables missing: ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

records <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    source_row = row_number(),

    creation_date = parse_date(
      as.character(fecha_creacion_caso),
      format = "%d%b%Y",
      locale = locale("en")
    ),

    creation_year = year(creation_date),

    age_at_creation = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(edad_ano_creacion_caso)
    ),

    confirmed = toupper(
      trimws(as.character(ipd_cofirmado))
    ),

    discarded = toupper(
      trimws(as.character(ipd_descartado))
    ),

    confirmed_b = !is.na(confirmed) &
      !is.na(discarded) &
      confirmed == "SI" &
      discarded == "NO"
  )

checks <- tibble(
  Measure = c(
    "Total registry records",
    "Unique individuals",
    "Missing person IDs",
    "Missing/unparsed creation dates",
    "Missing ages"
  ),
  N = c(
    nrow(records),
    n_distinct(records$id_persona, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(is.na(records$id_persona)),
    sum(is.na(records$creation_date)),
    sum(is.na(records$age_at_creation))
  )
)

kable(
  checks,
  caption = "Registry data checks"
)

if (any(is.na(records$id_persona))) {
  stop("Missing person IDs require review.")
}
```

## Construct person-level population

```{r person-level}
# Determine confirmation across all records for each person.

confirmation_status <- records %>%
  group_by(id_persona) %>%
  summarise(
    ever_confirmed = any(confirmed_b),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Prefer dated records, but retain people whose
# records all have missing dates.

first_registry <- records %>%
  arrange(
    id_persona,
    is.na(creation_date),
    creation_date,
    source_row
  ) %>%
  group_by(id_persona) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

person_data <- first_registry %>%
  left_join(
    confirmation_status,
    by = "id_persona"
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(person_data) ==
    n_distinct(person_data$id_persona)
)

person_data %>%
  summarise(
    Registered_individuals = n(),
    Known_first_registration_year =
      sum(!is.na(creation_year)),
    Unknown_first_registration_year =
      sum(is.na(creation_year))
  ) %>%
  kable(
    caption = "Availability of first-registration year"
  )
```

## Overall confirmation proportion

```{r overall-confirmation}
person_data %>%
  summarise(
    Registered_N = n(),
    Confirmed_N = sum(ever_confirmed),
    Not_observed_confirmed_N = sum(!ever_confirmed),
    Confirmed_percent = round(
      100 * mean(ever_confirmed), 1
    )
  ) %>%
  kable(
    caption = "Overall person-level confirmation"
  )
```

## Prepare categories and summary function

```{r categories}
# Retain missing values as separate categories.

category <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[is.na(x) | x == ""] <- "Missing"
  x
}

# Region labels from the master codebook.

region_lookup <- region_codes %>%
  transmute(
    region_code = category(`Region Code`),
    region_name = as.character(`Region name`)
  ) %>%
  distinct(region_code, .keep_all = TRUE)

person_data <- person_data %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = cut(
      age_at_creation,
      breaks = c(
        -Inf, 14, 19, 24, 34, 44, 54, 65, Inf
      ),
      labels = c(
        "Under 15",
        "15-19",
        "20-24",
        "25-34",
        "35-44",
        "45-54",
        "55-65",
        "Over 65"
      )
    ),

    region_code = category(
      cmd_cod_deis_regi_benef
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    region_lookup,
    by = "region_code"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    region = case_when(
      region_code == "Missing" ~ "Missing",

      !is.na(region_name) &
        trimws(region_name) != "" ~
        paste(
          region_code,
          region_name,
          sep = " - "
        ),

      TRUE ~ paste(
        "Unmapped:",
        region_code
      )
    ),

    age_group = category(age_group),
    sex = category(cmd_sexo_benef),
    fonasa = category(cmd_carga_tramo_benef),

    establishment_level = category(
      desc_nivel_estab_crea_caso
    )
  )

# Reusable function for subgroup proportions.

confirmation_table <- function(data, group_var) {
  data %>%
    group_by(
      Category = .data[[group_var]]
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      Registered_N = n(),
      Confirmed_N = sum(ever_confirmed),
      Confirmed_percent = round(
        100 * mean(ever_confirmed), 1
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}
```

## Confirmation by calendar year of first registration

```{r confirmation-year}
year_table <- person_data %>%
  group_by(creation_year) %>%
  summarise(
    Registered_N = n(),
    Confirmed_N = sum(ever_confirmed),
    Confirmed_percent = round(
      100 * mean(ever_confirmed), 1
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(creation_year)

year_table %>%
  mutate(
    creation_year = if_else(
      is.na(creation_year),
      "Unknown",
      as.character(creation_year)
    )
  ) %>%
  kable(
    caption = "Confirmation by first-registration year"
  )
```

```{r confirmation-year-figure, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
year_plot_data <- year_table %>%
  filter(!is.na(creation_year))

ggplot(
  year_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = creation_year,
    y = Confirmed_percent
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = sort(
      unique(year_plot_data$creation_year)
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Confirmation by first-registration year",
    x = "Calendar year of first registration",
    y = "Individuals ever confirmed (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )
```
